title: Your city needs more power
body: Demand is higher than supply. Build a solar plant or wind turbine: clean power earns Eco Points and adds no CO2.

title: Fossil plants are cheap for a reason
body: Coal and gas cost less up front, but every tick they add CO2 and warm the planet. Compare that with free sunshine and wind.

title: Clean power is working
body: Solar and wind emit no CO2. Every kilowatt of clean power also earns Eco Points, so you can grow without warming the city.

title: Spend your Eco Points
body: Eco Points buy materials and land. Later they unlock a missile silo and nukes. Click Expand Land or Buy Materials in the build bar.

title: The planet is getting hotter
body: Warming above 2°C brings heat waves and storms. Replace fossil plants with clean power, plant parks, and protect forests.

title: Forests are carbon sinks
body: Trees soak up CO2 as they grow. Building on a forest releases some of that carbon, so build on grass when you can.

title: Connect your city
body: Roads boost the income of shops and factories next to them. A small road network pays for itself.

title: Missile silo unlocked
body: You have earned enough Eco Points to build a missile silo. Wars are costly for the climate: every launch adds CO2 and leaves fallout.

title: A rival attacked your city
body: Clean up the fallout and protect your buildings. A missile silo lets you strike back, but it will not undo the CO2.

title: Nukes unlocked
body: Nukes deal huge damage, but each one dumps CO2 into the air and leaves a lot of fallout. Use them only if you must.

title: Materials are running low
body: Build a factory for steady materials, or buy a batch with Eco Points. Factories emit CO2, so balance them with clean power.

title: Add a park
body: Parks make residents happier and earn a little Eco Points. They also help your city cope with a warmer climate.

title: One rival is out
body: Only one civilisation is still standing. Finish the fight, or focus on clean energy: your city's emissions are now the biggest part of the problem.

title: Victory!
body: Both rivals are defeated. Your city is safe, but the climate still needs you. Can you get emissions close to zero and keep the lights on?
